packageRules.description: The JDK in the setup-java steps is a toolchain choice made together with AGP and Kotlin, not a routine bump, so Renovate leaves it alone.

One PR a month for every non-breaking update (minor, patch, pin, digest) across libraries, plugins, the Gradle wrapper and GitHub Actions. Major updates are never in it, so a breaking change always gets its own PR.

All Compose dependencies together: Compose Multiplatform, Material 3, adaptive, icons and the androidx *-compose artifacts. Material 3 is versioned apart from Compose Multiplatform but pinned to the one it ships with, so they move in one PR and CI checks the pair.

All other Kotlin dependencies together: the compiler, its Gradle plugins and kotlinx. Keep this after the Compose rule, because the Compose compiler plugin shares the kotlin version key and belongs here.
